goal: Build a genuinely interactive, native-quality multi-platform product design system rather than palette-only or flattened screens

workstreams.name: BRAND_CORE
deliverables: Brand positioning for game intelligence and controlled assistance, not merely a shield/radar
3-5 distinct premium symbol constructions (do not simply recolor S)
Primary mark/wordmark/horizontal/stacked/monochrome/compact variants
Android adaptive foreground/background/mask/splash and Windows executable/installer/tray/favicon/app symbol
16/20/24/32/48/72/108px optical-size review and vector source

workstreams.name: ICONOGRAPHY
deliverables: One cohesive geometric icon family, grid/stroke/fill/rounding/optical rules

Home, Games, Intelligence, Assistant, Battle, PvE, PvP, Build, Character, Auction, Trade, Quest, Profession, Resource, Capture, Automation, Overlay, Security, Devices, Voice, Activity, Account, Billing, Updates, Diagnostics, Support, Stop
16/20/24/32dp-px icon masters and adaptive active/hover/focus/disabled/danger states
Glyph recognition at small sizes, RU/EN naming, platform-specific system-convention exceptions

workstreams.name: FOUNDATIONS
deliverables: Typographic display/body/data scales Cyrillic and Latin
Color study kept open; semantic state tokens isolated from hue
Spacing/elevation/surface/geometry/light and dark systems
Responsive mobile/tablet/desktop grids, density scales and accessible focus styles

workstreams.name: COMPONENTS
deliverables: Editable reusable Figma variants with auto-layout and states for buttons, icon buttons, forms, toggles, navigation, tabs, cards, lists, tables, menus, dialogs, filters, breadcrumbs, pagination, alerts, tooltips, charts
Progress bar/stepper/loading/skeleton/empty/offline/timeout/error/success/unknown/unavailable/stale/denied/revoked/Stop
Game source, confidence, timestamp, fact/inference/recommendation components
Behavior and keyboard/touch specs for each interactive component

workstreams.name: MOTION_NAVIGATION
deliverables: Explicit page-route graph and history/back handling
Interactive prototypes for modal, drawer, navigation, capture consent, assistant state, load/restore, Stop and failure recovery
Purposeful transitions and microinteractions, including reduced-motion alternative
No decorative pulse that obscures security/game state

workstreams.name: ANDROID
deliverables: Native mobile layouts for onboarding, authentication, home, games, game detail, capture permission, observation, recommendations, opt-in assistant, battle status, builds, activity, security, devices, diagnostics, subscription, settings
Phone and tablet layouts, system bars, adaptive and monochrome app icons, touch/gesture/back behavior
Unknown/permission refused/offline/stale/game version unsupported and per-app OEM permission flows

workstreams.name: WINDOWS_LAUNCHER_OVERLAY
deliverables: Windows launcher, Companion shell, host/game connectors, update/download progress and rollback states
WoW character/talents/PvE/PvP/auction/professions/quests/economy screen layouts as planned/unverified when appropriate
Overlay minimal/standard/expanded and voice permissions, Stop/kill switch, action confirmation, degraded/stale data
Window sizing, high DPI, keyboard and packaged-host visual behavior

workstreams.name: WEB_CONTROL
deliverables: Distinct authenticated routes for Overview, Intelligence, Games, Activity, Security, Devices, Account, Subscription, Billing, Settings, Support, Diagnostics and Admin
Auth/MFA/sessions/role denial/recovery, data loading, empty and error states
Responsive desktop/tablet/mobile navigation; protected Admin shell distinct from user site
Tables, filters, charts, keyboard focus, trusted provenance and permission-bound actions

workstreams.name: PUBLIC_WEBSITE
deliverables: Real multi-route site architecture, not one long page with faux tabs
Individual Home, Features, Games, WoW, Android, Companion, How It Works, Security, Pricing, FAQ, Support, About, Downloads, Legal pages
Distinct hero/section illustrations, meaningful header/footer/route transitions, responsive grids
SEO/meta/page headings/links, truthful product availability, download gates and mobile nav

workstreams.name: ILLUSTRATION_ASSETS
deliverables: High-resolution, nonpixelated and non-stock hero illustrations
Platform and gameplay process visuals without claiming working automation
Vector-first diagrams, product previews and device imagery
Defined asset license/provenance, export matrix and sizes

workstreams.name: ACCESSIBILITY_CONSISTENCY
deliverables: WCAG contrast and non-color-only states, screen-reader labels and 48dp Android / 44px Web/Companion targets
RU/EN text overflow, font scaling, RTL only if required, high contrast/forced colors/reduced motion
Optical alignment and fidelity pass of every brand/icon/component size
Cross-platform screenshot comparison, keyboard/TalkBack/NVDA test plans and acceptance evidence

completion: Deep design specification and interactive prototype ready for Owner visual review; no style selection or native release readiness implied
